notes.title: My Colony v2.0.0 Released
notes.content: My Colony has just been updated to v2.0.0 and is now live!  This should address loading issues some players have experienced, and I am sorry for that!  I have updated the icon a bit, changed up the title screen, and spruced up some of the UI elements slightly.  There were a lot of "under the hood" changes in this update, so let me know what issues you uncover!

notes.title: My Colony v1.35.0 Released

notes.title: Steam Deck Working Properly Now
notes.content: Thanks to everyone who reported issues with My Colony on the Steam Deck, I can confirm it is now working properly with the latest patch (released today).  Let me know if you have any more problems with it!
